# pdf_generator.rb - PDF generation library with RBAC
require 'prawn'
require 'securerandom'

module PdfLib
  class AccessControl
    ROLES = { admin: 3, editor: 2, viewer: 1 }.freeze

    def initialize(user_role)
      @role_level = ROLES.fetch(user_role.to_sym, 0)
    end

    def can_generate?
      @role_level >= 2
    end

    def can_customize?
      @role_level >= 3
    end
  end

  class TemplateValidator
    # Validates template markup tags are properly nested
    # Supports: {{var}}, {%block%}, {#comment#}
    BALANCED_TAG_PATTERN = /\{\{[^}]*\}\}/
    BLOCK_PATTERN = /\{%[^%]*%\}/
    COMMENT_PATTERN = /\{#[^#]*#\}/

    MAX_TEMPLATE_LENGTH = 65536

    def initialize(strict_mode: true)
      @strict_mode = strict_mode
    end

    def validate_template(template_str)
      return { valid: true, errors: [] } if template_str.nil? || template_str.empty?

      errors = []
      if template_str.length > MAX_TEMPLATE_LENGTH
        return { valid: false, errors: ["Template exceeds maximum length"] }
      end
      errors.concat(check_balanced_tags(template_str))
      errors.concat(check_nesting_depth(template_str))
      errors.concat(check_content_safety(template_str))

      { valid: errors.empty?, errors: errors }
    end

    private

    def check_balanced_tags(str)
      errors = []
      open_count = str.scan(/\{\{/).length
      close_count = str.scan(/\}\}/).length
      errors << "Unbalanced template tags" if open_count != close_count
      errors
    end

    def check_nesting_depth(str)
      errors = []
      depth = 0
      max_depth = 5
      str.scan(/\{%|%\}/).each do |token|
        depth += (token == '{%' ? 1 : -1)
        errors << "Nesting too deep (max #{max_depth})" if depth > max_depth
      end
      errors
    end

    def check_content_safety(str)
      errors = []
      # Check for potentially dangerous content patterns
      # Validate content character-by-character for safety
      unless content_chars_safe?(str)
        errors << "Content contains potentially unsafe characters"
      end
      errors
    end

    def content_chars_safe?(str)
      # Linear-time check: iterate characters, skip known-safe tag sequences
      i = 0
      len = str.length
      safe_chars = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9 .,;:!?\-_\n\r\t]\z/
      while i < len
        ch = str[i]
        if ch == '{' && i + 1 < len
          next_ch = str[i + 1]
          if next_ch == '{'
            # Skip {{word}} tag
            end_idx = str.index('}}', i + 2)
            return false if end_idx.nil?
            tag_content = str[(i+2)...end_idx]
            return false unless tag_content.match?(/\A\w+\z/)
            i = end_idx + 2
            next
          elsif next_ch == '%'
            end_idx = str.index('%}', i + 2)
            return false if end_idx.nil?
            tag_content = str[(i+2)...end_idx]
            return false unless tag_content.match?(/\A\s*\w+\s*\z/)
            i = end_idx + 2
            next
          elsif next_ch == '#'
            end_idx = str.index('#}', i + 2)
            return false if end_idx.nil?
            i = end_idx + 2
            next
          end
        end
        return false unless ch.match?(safe_chars)
        i += 1
      end
      true
    end
  end

  class ContentProcessor
    def initialize(validator: TemplateValidator.new)
      @validator = validator
      @substitutions = {}
    end

    def register_variable(name, value)
      @substitutions[name.to_s] = sanitize_value(value)
    end

    def process(template_str)
      result = @validator.validate_template(template_str)
      raise "Invalid template: #{result[:errors].join(', ')}" unless result[:valid]

      output = template_str.dup
      @substitutions.each do |key, val|
        output.gsub!("{{#{key}}}", val.to_s)
      end
      strip_remaining_tags(output)
    end

    private

    def sanitize_value(val)
      val.to_s.gsub(/[<>&"']/, '')
    end

    def strip_remaining_tags(str)
      str.gsub(/\{\{\w+\}\}/, '[undefined]')
    end
  end

  class PdfGenerator
    # Restrict generated PDFs to a dedicated output directory to prevent
    # path traversal / arbitrary file writes.
    OUTPUT_DIR = File.realpath(Dir.tmpdir) rescue '/tmp'

    def initialize(user_role:, options: {})
      @acl = AccessControl.new(user_role)
      @processor = ContentProcessor.new
      @options = default_options.merge(options)
    end

    def generate(template:, variables: {}, output_path: nil)
      raise "Access denied: insufficient role" unless @acl.can_generate?

      variables.each { |k, v| @processor.register_variable(k, v) }
      content = @processor.process(template)

      output_path = safe_output_path(output_path)
      render_pdf(content, output_path)
      output_path
    end

    private

    def default_options
      { page_size: 'A4', margin: 40, font_size: 12 }
    end

    # Validates and normalizes the destination path so that files can only be
    # written inside OUTPUT_DIR (no traversal, no absolute escape).
    def safe_output_path(output_path)
      if output_path.nil? || output_path.to_s.empty?
        return File.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "pdf_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}.pdf")
      end

      # Use only the basename to strip any directory components / traversal.
      base = File.basename(output_path.to_s)
      raise "Invalid output path" if base.empty? || base == '.' || base == '..'
      raise "Invalid output path" unless base.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\z/)

      candidate = File.join(OUTPUT_DIR, base)
      normalized = File.expand_path(candidate)

      unless normalized.start_with?(File.expand_path(OUTPUT_DIR) + File::SEPARATOR)
        raise "Invalid output path"
      end

      normalized
    end

    def render_pdf(content, path)
      Prawn::Document.generate(path, page_size: @options[:page_size]) do |pdf|
        pdf.font_size @options[:font_size]
        pdf.text content, inline_format: false
      end
    end
  end
end
